email.subject: POAP KINGS is recruiting — war-focused, builder-minded, 4,600+ trophies
email.body:
POAP KINGS is a competitive Clash Royale clan that takes Clan Wars seriously and builds real culture around it.

We have 42 members and 416,000 combined trophies. Our top players sit at 14,000 trophies. Our donation leaders like Th15_Guy and Vijay consistently show up for the clan week after week.

What makes us different: we run a Free Pass Royale program — the season's top war performer earns a free pass, paid for by our founder. We issue POAPs, collectible records of seasons and milestones, so your contributions actually get remembered. We also have Elixir, our own AI clan operator that tracks war performance, milestones, and clan history.

We want players who show up for war, donate to clanmates, and want to be part of something intentional. Real life comes first — we just ask that you're active and engaged when you play.

Requirement is 4,600 trophies. If that sounds like your kind of clan, come find us at https://poapkings.com

**POAP KINGS | #J2RGCRVG | 4,600 trophies required**

**Quick stats:**
- 42 members, 416,000 combined trophies
- Three members at the 14,000 trophy cap
- 5,600+ donations this week
- Active in Clan Wars every season

**Who we are:**

POAP KINGS is a four-month-old clan built by people who wanted something more intentional than a random public clan. We're competitive in Clan Wars and we actually track who contributes. Our founder built custom systems around the clan — including Elixir, an AI clan operator that keeps war stats, milestones, and clan history in one place.

We also run a Free Pass Royale program. Every season, the top war performer earns a free Pass Royale paid for by our founder. Last season it went to the only player who used every war deck on every single battle day. That kind of consistency gets noticed here.

On top of that, we issue POAPs — collectible on-chain records tied to seasons and milestones. Your time in this clan leaves a real record.

**Two players worth knowing:**
- **jaat @123** leads our season war fame standings through three races of consistent effort
- **Th15_Guy** leads the clan in donations this week with 570 — reliable every week

**What we want:**
- 4,600+ trophies
- Show up for war when you can
- Donate to clanmates
- Want to be part of a clan with actual culture, not just a leaderboard slot

Real life comes first. We don't guilt-trip. We just want players who are engaged when they play.

Find us at **https://poapkings.com** or search clan tag **#J2RGCRVG** in-game.
